title: Oriental Mindoro farmers gain new outlet in QC market

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Farmers from Oriental Mindoro now have an additional outlet to sell their agricultural produce to Metro Manila consumers through a newly opened Kadiwa retail store managed by a local cooperative. The Jubilee Oriental Mindoro Consumer Cooperative operates the store at Phase 1, Jubilee East Ville, Barangay Bagong Silangan in Quezon City. The Department of Agriculture (DA) in Mimaropa supported the farmers through its Agribusiness and Marketing Assistance Division and the Agribusiness and Marketing Assistance Service.
